events.title: MTV Launched: Video Killed The Radio Star
events.blurb: MTV launched on August 1, 1981, with The Buggles' 'Video Killed The Radio Star' as its first music video, revolutionising the music industry.

angles.name: MTV's Impact
angles.copy: Forty-five years ago today, MTV burst onto our screens, changing music forever. The irony? Its very first video was The Buggles' 'Video Killed The Radio Star.' Did it, though?

events.title: Oasis' Definitely Maybe Anniversary
events.blurb: Oasis released their iconic debut album, Definitely Maybe, on August 29, 1994, propelling them to stardom.

angles.name: Definitely Maybe Legacy
angles.copy: Twenty-two years ago this month, Oasis dropped 'Definitely Maybe'. That album defined a generation and still sounds as fresh as ever. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in music history, took place from August 15-18, 1969, in Bethel, New York.

angles.name: Peace, Love, & Music
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago today, the Woodstock Festival kicked off. Three days of peace, love, and iconic music that shaped a generation. Imagine being there!

events.title: Elvis Presley Tribute
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, the 'King of Rock and Roll,' passed away on August 16, 1977, at the age of 42.

angles.name: Remembering The King
angles.copy: Today marks the anniversary of the passing of Elvis Presley. His music and legend continue to inspire, proving why he'll always be The King.

events.title: Tupac Shakur Tribute
events.blurb: Tupac Shakur was shot on September 7, 1996, in Las Vegas, and tragically passed away six days later on September 13, 1996.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering Tupac Shakur and his undeniable impact on music and culture. His lyrical genius continues to resonate.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
events.blurb: Jimi Hendrix, widely regarded as one of the greatest guitarists of all time, passed away on September 18, 1970, at the age of 27.

angles.name: Guitar Legend
angles.copy: A tribute to the incomparable Jimi Hendrix, whose groundbreaking guitar work continues to inspire musicians worldwide. A true legend.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their eleventh studio album, Abbey Road, featuring its iconic zebra crossing cover, on September 26, 1969.

angles.name: Iconic Album
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago this month, The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That cover, those songs... pure genius. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the American-British singer, songwriter, and founding member of The Pretenders, was born on September 7, 1951.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! Her voice and attitude with The Pretenders remain as powerful as ever.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the distinctive frontman of Oasis and Beady Eye, was born on September 21, 1972.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54 today! Happy birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. Still bringing that rock 'n' roll swagger.

events.title: John Lennon's Imagine Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon released his iconic song 'Imagine' as a single in the UK on October 24, 1975, delivering a message of peace and unity.

angles.name: Imagine Peace
angles.copy: Fifty-one years ago this month, John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released. Its message of peace and hope resonates just as strongly today.

events.title: First iPod Released Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the first iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising portable music players and how we consume music.

angles.name: iPod Revolution
angles.copy: Remember the original iPod? Twenty-five years ago this month, it changed everything. Suddenly, you could carry a thousand songs in your pocket. What was the first album you loaded on yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the release of the very first 007 film, Dr. No, which premiered on October 5, 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Celebrating 007's cinematic debut with 'Dr. No' back in '62. Who's your favourite Bond, and what's the ultimate Bond theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon, the iconic singer-songwriter and member of The Beatles, was born on October 9, 1940.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: Today, we remember John Lennon, who would have been 86. His music and message of peace continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: John Cleese, the legendary English actor, comedian, and writer, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, was born on October 27, 1939.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the comedic genius, John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, his work is simply timeless.

events.title: The Beatles' White Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their experimental double album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but known as the 'White Album,' on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Legacy
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago this month, The Beatles unveiled their ambitious 'White Album'. A sprawling masterpiece that proved their versatility. What's your hidden gem from the tracklist?
